mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_session_slot WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO s_session_slot ( venue_id, court_id, sport_type_id, weekly_slot_id, slot_date, start_at, end_at, price_fen, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{venueId}, #{courtId}, #{sportTypeId}, #{weeklySlotId}, #{slotDate}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{priceFen}, #{status}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE s_session_slot SET sport_type_id = #{sportTypeId}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, price_fen = #{priceFen}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE weekly_slot_id = #{weeklySlotId} AND slot_date = #{slotDate} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ss.court_id AS courtId, c.name AS courtName, ss.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, st.name AS sportName, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ss.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS startAt, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(ss.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS endAt, ss.price_fen AS priceFen, ss.status FROM s_session_slot ss JOIN s_court c ON c.id = ss.court_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = ss.sport_type_id WHERE ss.venue_id = #{venueId} AND ss.slot_date = #{date} ORDER BY ss.start_at, c.name
